what_this_is: An append-only Phase-10 provenance layer pinning the synthesis validator. It rewrites no earlier registry.

scripts/validate_phase8.py.semantics: Pre-opening-frozen Phase-8 validator. Asserts exact equality between HEAD and the pre-test snapshot; that assertion is intentionally false after the authorized locked-evaluation checkpoint. Preserved as historical evidence, never patched.

scripts/validate_phase8_postopening.py.semantics: Post-opening final-state validator. Uses immutable freeze-point ancestry instead of exact HEAD equality, and tolerates exactly the Phase-3 historical seal cascade and the two historical exact-HEAD gates.

scripts/validate_phase9.py.semantics: Post-test exploratory validator. Frozen before Phase-9 analysis; checks structure, definitions and reconciliation, never conclusions.

scripts/validate_phase10.py.semantics: Final-synthesis validator. Frozen before any Phase-10 synthesis output; gates classification, traceability, arithmetic and prohibited claims.
